question: Who won the 2027 Nobel Prize in Literature?

subquestions: Who was awarded the 2027 Nobel Prize in Literature?

observations.content:
[1] List of Nobel laureates in Literature - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Nobel_laureates_in_Literature
    As of 2026, the Nobel Prize in Literature has been awarded to 123 individuals.

[2] 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature - Wikipedia
    https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Nobel_Prize_in_Literature
    The 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature has been awarded to Canadian poet Anne Carson "for her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature."

[3] All Nobel Prizes in Literature - NobelPrize.org
    https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/lists/all-nobel-prizes-in-literature/
    All Nobel Prizes in Literature The Nobel Prize in Literature has been awarded 119 times to 123 Nobel Prize laureates between 1901 and 2026. Click on the links to get more information.

[4] The Nobel Prize in Literature
    https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/literature/
    The Nobel Prize in Literature 2026 was awarded to the Canadian author Anne Carson “for her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature.”

[5] The Awards Reckoning: Five Predictions for Prize Season 2027
    https://publishingpost.com/the-awards-reckoning-five-predictions-for-prize-season-2027/
    Oct 14, 2026 · Here, based on conversations with six publishing insiders — including two imprint publishers, a senior agent at a top-ten firm, and a foreign-rights director — are five predictions for what prize culture looks like by August 2027. Will the National Book Award Finally Overhaul Its Judging Structure?
